execution.trigger: Calling newOwner with a non-zero address.
execution.state_issue: The function allows any non-zero address to set itself as the owner.
execution.exploitable_behavior: An attacker can bypass normal access controls by passing their own address.

causality.state: The _owner parameter is not validated against ownership rights.
causality.guard: The onlyOwner modifier does not check if _owner has permission to set themselves as owner.
causality.transition: The function bypasses access control checks by directly setting the owner.
causality.capability: An attacker can assign any non-zero address as their own owner.
